Double up — two 48MP cameras

A wide-angle and a medium tele camera, both 1/1.3-inch 48MP, cover sweeping scenery and closer zoom views from the same flight.

4K/60fps HDR, day and night

4K/60fps HDR video and 4K/100fps slow motion, with Night Shots and 10-bit D-Log M and HLG for flexible colour in post.

46 minutes, 20 km, sensing all around

Up to 46 minutes of flight time, DJI O4 transmission up to 20 km, and omnidirectional obstacle sensing with APAS 5.0.

About this product

DJI Air 3
